import BanachIsometric.RealFunctionalRigidity
import BanachIsometric.RealOddSeminormTorsion

/-! The real case of Theorem D. The proportionality conclusion holds on
the original algebraic space. The norm model carries the uniformity
generated by the original family. -/

noncomputable section
namespace BanachIsometric

variable {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]

theorem real_seminorm_zero_or_positiveGaugeData_of_similarities
    (p : Seminorm ℝ X) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hdim : (n : Cardinal) < Module.rank ℝ X) (hsim : RealSeminormSubspaceSimilarities p n) :
    (∀ x, p x = 0) ∨ Nonempty (MetricGeometry.PositiveGaugeData (p : X → ℝ)) := by
  rcases zero_or_definite_of_subspace_similarities p (MetricGeometry.seminormZeroSubmodule ℝ p)
    (fun _ => Iff.rfl) n (by omega) hdim hsim with hzero | hdef
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  · right
    let M := MetricGeometry.DefiniteSeminormModel p hdef
    letI : NormedSpace ℝ M :=
      { inferInstanceAs (Module ℝ M) with norm_smul_le := fun a x => (norm_smul a x).le }
    let e : X ≃ₗ[ℝ] M := MetricGeometry.toDefiniteSeminormModel p hdef
    have hPair : SimultaneousPairSimilarities (𝕜 := ℝ) n (p : X → ℝ) p := by
      intro E F hE hF
      obtain ⟨T, c, hc, hT⟩ := hsim E F hE hF
      exact ⟨T, c, c, hc, hc, hT, hT⟩
    have hPairM := hPair.map e
    have hnorm : (fun y : M => p (e.symm y)) = norm := rfl
    rw [hnorm] at hPairM
    have hm : MetricSubspaceHomogeneity ℝ M n := by
      intro E F hE hF
      obtain ⟨T, c, _, hc, _, hT, _⟩ := hPairM E F
        (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq hE) (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq hF)
      exact ⟨(normalizedLinearSimilarity T c hc hT).toIsometryEquiv⟩
    obtain ⟨D⟩ := real_norm_positiveGaugeData hn (e.rank_eq.symm ▸ hdim) hm
    exact ⟨D.comap e.toLinearMap e.injective⟩

/-- The real Theorem D on the original algebraic module. The chosen nonzero
seminorm is the square root of the diagonal of the positive form. -/
theorem realTheoremD
    {ι : Type*} (p : ι → Seminorm ℝ X) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hdim : (n : Cardinal) < Module.rank ℝ X)
    (hseparating : ∀ x : X, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, p i x ≠ 0)
    (hsim : ∀ E F : Submodule ℝ X, Module.finrank ℝ E = n → Module.finrank ℝ F = n →
      ∃ T : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] F, ∀ i, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ x : E, p i (T x : X) = c * p i (x : X)) :
    ∃ i₀ : ι, ∃ _D : MetricGeometry.PositiveGaugeData (p i₀ : X → ℝ),
      ∀ i, (∀ x, p i x = 0) ∨ ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ ∀ x, p i x = a * p i₀ x := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := rank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp ((zero_le (n : Cardinal)).trans_lt hdim)
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hseparating x₀ hx₀
  have hsingle (i : ι) : RealSeminormSubspaceSimilarities (p i) n := by
    intro E F hE hF
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hsim E F hE hF
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hp⟩ := hT i
    exact ⟨T, c, hc, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := (real_seminorm_zero_or_positiveGaugeData_of_similarities (p i₀) hn hdim
    (hsingle i₀)).resolve_left (fun hz => hi₀ (hz x₀))
  refine ⟨i₀, D, ?_⟩
  intro i
  rcases real_seminorm_zero_or_positiveGaugeData_of_similarities (p i) hn hdim (hsingle i) with
    hzero | hDi
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  · obtain ⟨Di⟩ := hDi
    refine Or.inr (positiveGaugeData_proportional_of_simultaneous_real_similarities D Di hn hdim ?_)
    intro E F hE hF
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hsim E F hE hF
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hp₀⟩ := hT i₀
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hp⟩ := hT i
    exact ⟨T, c₀, c, hc₀, hc, hp₀, hp⟩

theorem realTheoremD_normable [UniformSpace X] [IsUniformAddGroup X]
    {ι : Type*} (p : ι → Seminorm ℝ X) (hp : WithSeminorms p) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hdim : (n : Cardinal) < Module.rank ℝ X)
    (hseparating : ∀ x : X, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, p i x ≠ 0)
    (hsim : ∀ E F : Submodule ℝ X, Module.finrank ℝ E = n → Module.finrank ℝ F = n →
      ∃ T : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] F, ∀ i, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ x : E, p i (T x : X) = c * p i (x : X)) :
    ∃ i₀ : ι, ∃ D : MetricGeometry.PositiveGaugeData (p i₀ : X → ℝ),
      (∃ e : X ≃L[ℝ] MetricGeometry.GaugeNormModel D,
        UniformContinuous e ∧ UniformContinuous e.symm ∧ ∀ x, ‖e x‖ = p i₀ x) ∧
      (∀ i, (∀ x, p i x = 0) ∨ ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ ∀ x, p i x = a * p i₀ x) ∧
      (CompleteSpace X → CompleteSpace (MetricGeometry.GaugeNormModel D)) := by
  obtain ⟨i₀, D, hcollapse⟩ := realTheoremD p hn hdim hseparating hsim
  let e := MetricGeometry.toGaugeNormModel D
  have hnorm (x : X) : ‖e x‖ = p i₀ x := MetricGeometry.norm_gaugeNormModel D (e x)
  let u := seminormFamilyNormUniformEquiv p hp i₀ e.toAddEquiv hnorm hcollapse
  refine ⟨i₀, D, ⟨seminormFamilyNormContinuousLinearEquiv p hp i₀ e hnorm hcollapse,
    u.uniformContinuous, u.symm.uniformContinuous, hnorm⟩, hcollapse, ?_⟩
  intro hcomplete
  exact u.completeSpace_iff.mp hcomplete

end BanachIsometric
